description: This file contains a class implementing Drupal hook functions related to system tokens, providing token information and processing for site-wide and date-related tokens.

classes.name: SystemTokensHooks
classes.description: A class implementing Drupal hook functions for system tokens, providing token info and processing for site and date tokens.

methods.name: tokenInfo
methods.description: Provides information about available tokens for site and date types, including site details and date formats.

methods.name: tokens
methods.description: Processes token replacements for 'site' and 'date' token types, generating appropriate values based on configuration and current date/time.
